deviceDiscovery._comment: Silent background sweep: mutes each Echo, plays a ~250ms silent track via the skill, stops, restores volume — binds rotated Alexa skill deviceIds to hardware serials without audible playback. POST /api/devices/discover?force=1 to run immediately.

claude._comment: Optional. Powers Mix Muse conversational playlists (Anthropic API).

openai._comment: Optional. Alternative LLM provider for Mix Muse (OpenAI API).

mixMuse._comment: Optional. Force provider: claude | openai. Auto-detects from keys if omitted.

alexaRemote._comment: Optional. Enables 'Play on device' in the web UI via the unofficial Alexa API (alexapy). Use Settings → Start browser login, or scripts/alexa_login.py --proxy. For remote login, forward TCP 3005 and set loginProxyHost to your public IP (e.g. 142.56.8.193).

mobileApi._comment: Required for Android app over port-forward or Cloudflare tunnel. Generate token: python3 -c "import secrets; print(secrets.token_urlsafe(32))"

appDownload._comment: Basic auth for GET /app and mobile app downloads (Android APK + iPhone IPA). Falls back to WebPassword if password omitted.
appDownload._releaseNotes: Edit app-release-notes.json in the repo root whenever you upload a new build.

alexaAplLyrics._comment: Echo Show karaoke lyrics via APL. Requires skill manifest APL interface + redeploy. See docs/ECHO_SHOW_APL_LYRICS.md.

appAbout._comment: Links shown in mobile app About screen (account menu).
